newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Tutu in hospital for prostate probe.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Tutu in hospital for prostate probe.

text.p: South African Nobel peace laureate Desmond Tutu has been admitted to hospital for prostate gland treatment, a close associate said on Thursday.

Alex Boraine, Tutu's deputy chairman on the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, told a news conference Tutu had been admitted on Wednesday and a sample of his prostate gland had been taken for further analysis. He would remain in hospital over the weekend.
"He's in very good spirits, he's well," Boraine said. "There's no cause for any alarm."
